title: Oasis of Peace
meta: Show garden · BBC Gardeners’ World Live, 2019
summary: A Moroccan and Mediterranean-inspired show garden: an island of fragrant planting ringed by shallow water.
intro: Created for a couple who live in step with nature and wildlife, this garden draws on Moroccan and Mediterranean ideas: patterned tiling, moving water and fragrant planting chosen for pollinators.
A shallow pool encircles a central island, where visitors can slip off their shoes and cool their feet on a hot day. Behind the bench, a sculpture of three oversized elements is lit by day and night.
facts: Silver Award and People’s Choice Award, as recorded on our previous website
alt: Oasis of Peace show garden at BBC Gardeners’ World Live

title: Japanese Garden
meta: London · Designed and built by Morgan Oates
summary: A hidden, calm retreat of maples, rock and water, reached along a curving, overgrown path.
intro: Designed and built for a client who knows Japanese garden style and philosophy well. The brief was a calm, slightly secret retreat, tucked behind a curving walkway.

A bean-shaped pond is the centre of the garden, with a rockery waterfall visible from a gazebo built out over the water. That meant substantial groundwork before any planting began. Maples, rock and water do the rest.
alt: Japanese-style garden with pond, rocks and maples

title: West London Romantic Style Garden
meta: West London · Designed and built by Morgan Oates
summary: A compact, enclosed sensory garden of scent, birdsong and soft layered planting.
intro: A private, enclosed retreat for a young professional who works in the city centre and wanted to feel closer to nature. The concept rests on scent, birdsong and bees and butterflies, with a water feature for birds to bathe in.

The small site is used to its full potential. An existing lawn was being taken over by mind-your-own-business, so the design embraces it as a soft, cushioning ground cover, layered with shade-tolerant perennials and a few evergreen shrubs.
alt: Romantic-style walled garden in West London

title: Central London Garden
summary: A dark basement entrance turned into a green, welcoming approach.
intro: The entrance to a basement flat in central London, dark and shuttered, which limited what would grow. The design uses a faux living wall and trellis panels to cover the walls and a storage door.

Two tall planters of shade-loving evergreen climbers screen an unattractive staircase, spaced so the stairs stay accessible. A fern tree in a feature pot is reflected in a bespoke wooden-framed mirror outside the main bedroom. Furniture and a patterned carpet make the space feel lived in.
alt: Shaded basement-flat entrance garden in central London

title: Cheltenham Town House and Garden
summary: A four-bedroom Arts and Crafts town house, and a working garden for a keen gardener.
intro: The redevelopment of a four-bedroom Arts and Crafts town house and its garden. Inside: new oak floors, rewiring and replumbing, relocated walls with structural steel, a bespoke kitchen and joinery, new staircase balustrades and new steel doors and windows.

Outside, a working garden for a keen gardener: a garden office, a silver birch woodland walk with low grasses, raised oak sleeper beds for fruit and vegetables, brick-edged hogging paths, a composting and working area, full irrigation to front and rear and a mood-changing lighting system.
alt: Cheltenham town house garden with sleeper beds and paths
